# WeekFlow

WeekFlow is a weekly planning workspace for organizing plans, daily activity, follow-ups, review, and reporting.

WeekFlow helps people plan a week, capture daily activity, keep follow-ups visible, review progress, and create a professional weekly report in one workspace.

## Public pages

- Homepage: https://myweekflow.netlify.app/
- Sign in: https://myweekflow.netlify.app/sign-in
- Create an account: https://myweekflow.netlify.app/sign-up

## Product rhythm

WeekFlow brings together Weekly Plan, Daily Activity, Follow-ups, Generate Report, and Report History in one workflow.

## Workflows

WeekFlow supports different work patterns including business operations, field operations, project management, NGO and community work, education, personal productivity, and custom workflows.
